conditions.dry: air dispersion VIBRI/RODOS; sieved 10 g; 80% conveying speed; 2.5 bar primary dispersion pressure (not brewing pressure)
conditions.wet25: non-sieved: 10 g in 300 mL demineralized water, stirred 20 min at 25 C; direct aliquot; ultrasound 60 s; pause 10 s; four 10 s readings with 5 s pauses; pump 30%
conditions.wet90: 10 g in 300 mL boiled demineralized water; starts 90 C and cools to about 60 C over 20 min stirring; not isothermal
conditions.prepared_wet90: after hot treatment: retain on 200 um sieve; wash 5 min; add to dispersant, wait 5 min; no ultrasound; four 120 s readings with 5 s pauses; pump 30%

preparation.common: EK43; vibrational sieving plus brush; air-jet 5 min, 70 m3/hour, 50 rpm for prepared fractions
preparation.limitation: prepared retained selections, not particle-level pairs or interchangeable with non-sieved operators

ambiguities.resolution: caption names L; artwork shows two pairs and p3964 prose/figure6 name S/M; exclude invented light L
midpoint coordinates authenticated; exact physical cutoff mapping unresolved

published_uncertainty: displayed PSD error bars: 95% confidence intervals, source t-distribution; simultaneous coverage/covariance and raw replicates unavailable; no family-wide test

layers.G: marker centres widened by graphical reading/calibration uncertainty
layers.P: identifiable cumulative CI endpoints widened by same allowances; unsupported otherwise

hypotheses.B: separate lambda_c>=1 per wet condition; Fwet(d)=Fdry(d/lambda_c)
hypotheses.C: lambda>=1 shared across fixed quantiles within each fraction, then across designated fractions within roast

classification_precedence: inconsistent retained CDFs block affected decisions
any supported strict witness excludes despite unrelated missing requests
complete non-excluding comparisons / nonempty outer intersection
rounding: exact Fraction arithmetic; Decimal correctly-rounded ln/exp with directed enclosure, then outward to 0.000001 um; displays outward
relaxation: shared-axis provenance retained; marginal rectangular outer enclosure used for exclusions, not joint feasibility
source_outlier_exclusions: provenance only; retain all requested quantiles including q=.99
